name: history
tier_note: Tiers = conceptual difficulty (T1 ~grade5 simple/concrete .. T5 ~grade9-10 analytic), NOT obscurity. Grade-10 ceiling. Aim ~30%+ of rungs at T1-T2.
voice_rule: THE WONDER PATTERN: the answer is the MOST memorable specific cool fact. Hierarchy: NAMED THINGS (Excalibur, "Annus mirabilis", Mjolnir) > VIVID ACTIONS (Hercules strangling the lion; Joan offering to fight a whole gang) > OBJECTS > NUMBERS (ONLY when the stem CONSTRUCTS the number -- builds an expectation it shatters, e.g. Everett's 13,000 words -> Lincoln's 272; a number asked COLD = randomness, BANNED) > GENERIC LABELS (a venue/date/category as the answer = BANNED). Dinner Test: would a kid excitedly retell this answer at dinner? Drama-Available Rule: if the stem has drama (fire, blood, a trial, last words), the answer can NEVER be a venue/date/label.
framing: Apply each topic's framing_note (moral_vision) for stance + mandated emphasis; never WARP content to force a principle in.
